name: Arjun Verma
bio: Arjun's journey into motorsport began later in life, after a successful career in IT project management. He always held a deep passion for racing, attending local events whenever possible. A chance encounter with a team owner at a charity function led to an opportunity to apply his organizational and strategic skills to the world of racing. As a Sporting Director, Arjun prioritizes clear communication and collaborative problem-solving. He believes that a team's success hinges on creating a supportive and empowering environment where every member feels valued and heard. He is eager to prove that his unique background can bring a fresh perspective to the often-insular world of motorsport management.

physical.description: Arjun is a slightly portly man with a warm smile and kind eyes, often seen adjusting his glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas.
Refuses to start a meeting without offering everyone chai.
Has a habit of using analogies from cricket to explain racing strategy.
